scope: N02 direct application collection through unchanged I2C register engine and logical resources; no actual IRQ/pin/clock/wire validation
progress: explicit poll; each call at most one dispatch OR one Master::step, followed by bounded reap/close
time_input: updates logical now and PD/virtual touch only, does not poll I2C
reclaim: backend reap/close releases peripheral lease, outer storage/result held until application take
native_wire_command: host-only macro of register stimuli and explicit poll calls; not a firmware blocking API or IRQ implementation
